story: This footage is presented as a news report from 'itv News', indicated by a logo in the top right and a text overlay reading 'Crawling criminals caught on camera'. The initial CCTV segment shows the indoor view of a shop containing mugs, a screen, and a clipboard. Two masked individuals are seen crawling on the floor; the person in the rear is carrying a crowbar. They proceed to drag a package box while crawling backwards. The scene then transitions to different footage where one of the culprits strikes a CCTV camera directly with the crowbar, while their photos are displayed on the news broadcast. The final scene shows one of the robbers being forcefully pulled out of a red car by an unidentified person.
